candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow-safe check with a failing require that blocks all deposits by requiring depositsCount + 1 > depositsCount (strict inequality), causing receive to revert and not increment.
Remove the require check so receive always increments depositsCount when Ether is sent.
Change increment to a decrement so receive decreases depositsCount on each call, altering the observable state.
Replace the increment with a double-increment so receive increases depositsCount by 2 per call.
Add an explicit check that reverts when depositsCount is already nonzero, preventing further increments after the first deposit.
